externalDependencies.notes: External dependencies are intentionally referenced rather than duplicated. They remain dependency-level needsReview items during this source-only audit.

metadata.copyrightBoundary: Long narrative prose and artwork are excluded; names, numbers, formulas, short mechanical summaries, choices, relationships, tables used for resolution, and stat data are retained as structured game data.
